verdict.rationale: Whether a SaaS observability and incident-management platform publishes its source under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an open-source license, a public source repository, or source availability. The MCP server, APIs and Terraform items concern integration, not source openness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
